niche.title: The Worst Medical Treatment in History: The Death of Charles II
niche.description:
In February 1685, King Charles II of England collapsed while being shaved. Over the next four days, a crowd of the best doctors in Europe bled him, purged him, blistered his scalp, tied pigeon droppings to his feet and fed him drops made from a human skull. At the end, the King apologized to them.

So did his doctors save him, or did they make his last days worse? And why did smart, educated people believe every one of those treatments worked?
